protectedPaths.reason: the binding specification; changing it changes what every rule and adapter must do

a checked-out project config, including this repository's own — nothing else in the repository technically stops an agent from editing one; see CONTRACTS.md §8 on the deferred blast radius of this control

forbidden.reason: this repository declares no dependencies and must keep it that way — it installs onto machines whose Node version we do not control, and every dependency is a new way for the install to fail

an uncapped run pools one worker per CPU core, and several of this suite's tests shell out to the real CLI from inside a worker, multiplying that into several times as many live node processes on a machine an agent is meant to keep using for other work at the same time (modules/memory-as-context/seed/infra-test-run-resource-cap.md). Run `npm run test:capped` instead (node tests/run.js --workers 6), or pass --workers/SOFTELA_AI_TEST_WORKERS yourself for a filtered or --strict-skips run

code.reason: this repository is developer infrastructure, not a product — file-size limits, folder shape, naming and reuse checks target application code and have no target here
